title: This review did not cover analytics jobs, peak load, security or the payment database
summary: Five areas are outside this review. Confirm that you read the list, or name an owner for a gap in your comment.

blocks.title: Not covered
blocks.html:
• The analytics replica. 12 ETL jobs read the MySQL replica directly. I did not read them. [UNVERIFIED]
  • The peak load. The load test reached 600 writes/s. The last peak was 1,450 writes/s. [UNVERIFIED]
  • Security. Database roles, secrets and network rules for the new instances.
  • The payment database. It is a separate system.
  • Legal review. Data residency of the new instance region.

[src: report.md]

blocks.title: What I suggest
blocks.html: The peak load test is already a go/no-go gate (D5). For the other four areas, name an owner or mark them out of scope. If the ETL jobs use MySQL-only SQL, they fail after the cutover, like the queries in F1.
